Circuit Civil Court
Filing a Case in the Circuit Civil Division
The Circuit Civil Division handles civil actions in which the damages being sought or the matter in controversy is $50,000 and above.
Common Cases
Negligence
Professional or Medical Malpractice
Contract and Indebtedness Disputes
Actions relating to Real Property
Mortgage Foreclosures
Eminent Domain Suits
Declaratory Judgments
Injunctions
Interpleader
Replevins
Writs of Certiorari
Habeas Corpus Proceedings
All other civil actions that do not fall within the jurisdiction of the County Court
Due to the complex legal nature of these cases, the Circuit Civil Division cannot offer advice on how to proceed with these actions.
